name: payroll-system
description: Payroll for a multi-hub retail business: guys/supervisors and managers, auto-calculated from daily/weekly logs

scripts.demo: node --no-warnings seed.js data/demo && node --no-warnings server.js data/demo
scripts.demo:october: node --no-warnings seed.js data/october --open=2026-10 && node --no-warnings server.js data/october
